Definition: of Hebrew origin (H5941); Heli (i.e. Eli), an Israelite:--Heli.
BiblicalUsage: Heli is a name that appears in the genealogy of Jesus, as the father of Joseph. In Luke 3:23 Jesus begins his ministry at about thirty years of age, being the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli, and the line runs back through David to Adam and to God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the genealogy is the proof that Jesus belongs to a real family with real fathers: Heli's name stands in the line, and the line ends in the Son of God.
